hypothesis: Above-zero STLFSI4 denotes broad financial stress and predicts adverse crypto risk appetite; short the equal-weight crypto basket only after a conservative 7-day availability lag.
rationale: Zero is the index's economically natural stress boundary, not a sample-fitted quantile. Seven calendar days is deliberately conservative for weekly macro availability and prevents same-observation-date use.
gate: Aggregate and every chronological fold must have return > 0 and daily PF > 1 under base costs; aggregate severe and supersevere must each have return > 0 and daily PF > 1; gross cap and invariants must pass.
